svg.title: Postel's law
svg.desc: Three partner apps send orders with quirks: country usa, price as text, country United States. Left: a forgiving orders API accepts all of it in year 1, and in year 3 a strict rewrite on a 5% canary fails 18% of partner requests. Right: a strict API answers 400 and names the bad field, the partners fix it once, and in year 3 every request still passes.
svg.text: 400: country must be a 2 letter ISO code, like US
Forgiven quirks became the contract. Strict errors got fixed on day one.
